audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gave every one of the seven rows to Ryze while the prose (whys, early/mid, spikes) and the 72.22% win rate all describe Nautilus dominating levels 2 through first item.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill / Nautilus x5 / Ryze, and Ryze is immobile and squishy inside Dredge Line's 1150 range until items.
audit.corrected: Level 1 Skill, Levels 2 through first item Nautilus, 2+ items Ryze; ratings flipped to match.

audit.why: Spikes are Nautilus lvl 2-3 full pattern, lvl 6 Depth Charge, Iceborn Gauntlet; Ryze at 2+ items with Tear online. Matches the flipped chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rune Prison described as a 'point-blank root that sets up his combo'. It is 615 range and only ROOTS when Spell Flux (E) is already on the target; otherwise it is a slow. Ryze's R was called a math-changing ultimate at 6, but Realm Warp is a delayed 3000-range group portal.
audit.why: Riot text: 'If the target has Flux on it, they are instead rooted.' The bait order is E first, not W.
audit.corrected: Bait Spell Flux; unfluxed Rune Prison is only a slow. Depth Charge (120/100/80) is point-click and homing, so Realm Warp's delayed portal does not shake it.

edits.before: Weather the poke — hook him on the Rune Prison cooldown and chain the CC. Nautilus wins the Rune Prison cooldown windows.
edits.after: Weather the poke — hook him at 1150 when Rune Prison is down and chain passive root into E slow. Nautilus wins those windows.

edits.before: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rune Prison only roots if Spell Flux is on you — bait the E orb first, then it is just a slow.

edits.before: Track Ryze's Rune Prison: His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. When it is down — Hook + passive root chain.
edits.after: Rune Prison roots only with Spell Flux on you, else it slows: bait the E orb, then hook at 1150 and chain passive root into E.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison: matchup-defining — His point-blank root — sets up his combo. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ryze Rune Prison: 9-11s, roots only with Spell Flux on you — bait the E orb and it is a slow. Track it before every engage. - Dredge Line: never spend it on chip. - Depth Charge: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Depth Charge is an unmissable point-click knockup — the all-in always starts. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Ryze's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Depth Charge is unmissable point-click lockdown — the all-in always starts. Realm Warp is a delayed group portal, not an escape from your R chain.

notes: Only 18 games in the packet, so the 72.22% win rate is thin; chart flipped to match the packet levelChart and the existing prose rather than the win rate alone. diff/diffRating left at EVEN / 7.5-8.5 given the small sample.
